title: The new PharmaWRK BMS
notes: The BMS now runs on the new PharmaWRK system, at the same address: bms.pharmawrk.com.
Sign in with your work email. We send a 6-digit code to that email; there is no password to remember.
Support Cases: notification settings now have their own To and CC lists for each severity (Low, Normal, High, Urgent). When a severity has no list of its own, the default To and CC are used.

Support Cases: while a case is waiting on the customer, they get a reminder in the case's email thread (every day by default). If there is still no answer 3 days after our last reply, the case is closed automatically. Both can be switched off or changed in the notification settings.
For your security, sign-in details that the old BMS kept in your browser for "Remember me" are now removed automatically.
New: "What's new" notes like these. When a newer version of the BMS is released, an open page refreshes itself, or asks you to refresh if you are in the middle of something.
